preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of SWAG Traits for each test case is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The size of each SWAG Trait is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each element in a SWAG Trait is a positive integer less than or equal to 1000.

postconditions.description: The Swag Level of RK is the sum of the integers removed by RK from the SWAG Traits.
The Swag Level of RG is the sum of the integers removed by RG from the SWAG Traits.

postconditions.expression: all(RK_moves[i] >= RG_moves[i] for i in range(len(RK_moves)))
postconditions.description: Both players play optimally, meaning RK will always try to maximize his Swag Level and RG will try to minimize it.
